provenance.preparation: Fresh natural default controllers; only the existing LCG is injected; audio remains Off.
provenance.observations: Existing sensing return values are observed without extra field sampling or RNG calls. Wrappers call original methods once.
provenance.evidence: E is the existing absolute local Hill strength. L/C/R are the existing averaged two-depth profiles. Commitment distributions use the actual committedRemaining countdown in seconds; no inferred A*E variable is introduced.
provenance.lowEvidenceDose: E < 0.1; dose and distance are accrued at GasterDeposition.advance. Deferred mixed dabs are not assigned current-tick evidence.
provenance.clocks: New clock pairs are detected by changed countdowns after updateIntention. Effective scheduled hold is min(decision, committed). Realized-hold distribution contains only intervals completed by another scheduling, including blockage interruptions; it excludes retirement-censored and active unfinished intervals. Their counts and elapsed durations are reported separately.
provenance.occupancy: 64x64 ant-center samples every simulation tick; counts / 60 are ant-seconds. Recent occupancy retains the last 30 completed one-second buckets.
provenance.persistence: Pheromone cells >= 0.04 in every one-second sample in the previous 30 seconds. Region count uses eight-neighbor components with at least 20 cells; this is a corridor-area proxy, not a branch or social graph.
provenance.plateBranches: Existing frozen Plate graph: degree >= 3 nodes joined by existing edges form junction clusters. Endpoints have degree 1. Grid diagonals/intersections can create junctions; these are graph proxies, not inferred behavior.
provenance.liveRouteBranches: The current birth candidate graph is read through the original pure createDescriptor method without publishing a birth. A live route qualifies after stableSeconds >= 20. BoundaryEndpointBranches counts degree-1 graph endpoints within 0.05 of the observation boundary; junction clusters remain a separate grid-dependent proxy. Missing/unqualified candidates have zero qualifying branches. This graph keeps only the existing source-to-distant-boundary paths.
provenance.persistentEndpoints: At 1 Hz, exact boundary endpoint cell identities from the current qualifying candidate are tracked. Missing/unqualified cells reset their age. Persistent20sEndpointCount requires at least 20 seconds between first and current consecutive observations (21 samples). It is an exact-grid temporal endpoint proxy: cell shifts reset it, and it does not establish a persistent whole branch or social graph.
provenance.earlyRoute: The 30 s pheromone >= 0.04 mask outside radius 0.12 around the entrance is frozen per run. Later dose and contact shares within it measure early-route retention, not individual-founder causality.
provenance.earlyRouteDose: Spatial dose share uses the gaster rear endpoint of each accrued movement chunk, before deferred dabs are emitted; it is an endpoint approximation.
provenance.maps: Raw unchanged 96x96 pheromone/surface and 64x64 occupancy grids; render with identical absolute scales across variants.
provenance.randomPairing: Same seed is an initial-condition pairing. Changed movement/recruitment can diverge RNG call paths; state and call count are recorded.
provenance.raw: Gzip archive contains all natural Plate descriptors/birth records, 1 Hz positions and one actual FOOT_CONTACT sample per occupied simulation-second; all contact events are hashed.
